_note: Short reading versions of the D3 recommendations (22 Oct 2026), written from the full text in partA_*.json and partB_decision_guide.json. Citations stay with the full text.

Supervised assessment.redesign: Secure a few key points in each degree with hands-on live checkoffs and tasks that ask students to correct AI-generated code

Unsupervised formats.problem: Easy to complete with AI; marks say little about unaided ability
Unsupervised formats.redesign: Keep as the main task, mark critique and reasoning, and add a short individual check

Oral assessments.problem: Staff time; anxiety and language effects
Oral assessments.redesign: Ten-minute structured vivas on the student's own work, sampled in large cohorts, with accessible alternatives

Practical demonstrations.redesign: Short live demos with a change made on request, on top of an AI-permitted project

Staged submissions.redesign: Few real milestones, with design before AI-assisted coding and at least one individual explanation

Process evidence.redesign: Capture records in a university workspace and have staff assess the quality of AI use

Personalised tasks.redesign: Use for realism, and pair with questions on the student's own work

AI-use declarations.redesign: Use for transparency only; capture AI use where it counts for marks

LO1|Small (<50).main: Short supervised tests on core concepts; online quizzes for practice only
LO1|Small (<50).check: The test itself, plus brief live questions for every student
LO1|Small (<50).ai: No AI in tests; AI for feedback on practice quizzes

LO1|Medium (50-200).main: Invigilated exam on core concepts; quizzes for practice only
LO1|Medium (50-200).check: The exam itself; an optional 10-minute viva for a 20% sample

LO1|Large (>200).main: Invigilated exam in existing venues, with quickly marked items
LO1|Large (>200).check: The exam itself; short orals only for risk-based cases

LO2|Small (<50).main: AI-permitted project in a repository with version history
LO2|Small (<50).check: Viva and live code demo with an on-the-spot change, for every student

LO2|Medium (50-200).main: AI-permitted assignments in a repository, auto-tested
LO2|Medium (50-200).check: 10-minute code walkthrough with a live change, for every student

LO2|Large (>200).main: AI-permitted assignments, auto-tested, plus a supervised lab test
LO2|Large (>200).check: Lab test for all; walkthroughs for a 20% sample and flagged cases
LO2|Large (>200).ai: Allowed on assignments; no AI in the lab test

LO3|Small (<50).main: Staged design project: design first, then AI-assisted build, then justification
LO3|Small (<50).check: Viva for every student at the final checkpoint
LO3|Small (<50).ai: Allowed once the design stage is complete

LO3|Medium (50-200).main: Staged design project with two or three marked stages
LO3|Medium (50-200).check: 10-minute viva at a key checkpoint, on the student's own design
LO3|Medium (50-200).ai: Allowed after an AI-free design stage

LO3|Large (>200).main: Staged design project plus a supervised design question in the exam
LO3|Large (>200).check: Exam question for all; design vivas for a 20% sample and flagged cases
LO3|Large (>200).ai: Allowed on the project; no AI in the exam question

LO4|Small (<50).main: Team project for a real client, with a shared repository and team prompt log
LO4|Small (<50).check: Viva on own contribution for every student, plus peer assessment
LO4|Small (<50).ai: Allowed; the team log records how AI output was used

LO4|Medium (50-200).main: Group project with a shared repository and a team record of AI use
LO4|Medium (50-200).check: 10-minute viva on own code with a live change, for every student

LO4|Large (>200).main: Capstone team project, treated as a secured point in the degree
LO4|Large (>200).check: Short individual viva or tutor conversation for every student

LO5|Small (<50).main: AI-integrated task in the University workspace; marks mainly for the quality of AI use
LO5|Small (<50).check: Live check from the record for every student (fallback: supervised AI-correction tasks)

LO5|Medium (50-200).main: AI-integrated task in the University workspace; marks mainly for the quality of AI use
LO5|Medium (50-200).check: Live check from the record, or supervised tasks correcting AI code
LO5|Medium (50-200).ai: Integrated and assessed; no AI in the exam correction tasks

LO5|Large (>200).main: AI-integrated task in the University workspace; marks mainly for the quality of AI use
LO5|Large (>200).check: Supervised AI-correction tasks for all; live checks for a sample and flagged cases
LO5|Large (>200).ai: Integrated and assessed; no AI in the exam tasks
